description: Variation of condition 2 for ref: 21/00739/FUL to allow increase in size of dormer, changes to first floor front window to include double glazing.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with 30th July 2021 (the date of the decision notice of planning application reference 21/00739/FUL).Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Section 73 applications cannot vary the original time limit).

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, Location PlanBlock Plan LR-01LR-02LR-03LR-04LR-05LR-06 Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Prior to any above ground works, details of the proposed materials including, tiles, fascia and new timber frame windows shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be a scale of 1:20 with 1:5 sections (including cills, reveals, heads, window furniture). The proposed materials and windows shall be installed in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance in the Lakes Conservation Area.The details submitted to the Local Planning Authority on 1 May 2024 pursuant to Condition 3 of Planning Permission Reference: 21/00739/FUL [Ref: 24/01417/CND] and approved by the Local Planning Authority on 26 June 2024 are deemed to form the approved details for the purposes of this condition.
